description: Validate configuration at startup and exit with a clear error, so a bad deploy is stopped before it serves traffic.
Zod 4 parser for boolean strings: `'true'`, `'1'`, `'yes'`, `'on'` and their opposites; anything else is an error. Unlike `z.coerce.boolean()`, `'false'` becomes `false`.
A refinement on the whole object that can add issues to specific paths, used for cross-field rules such as production-only requirements.
Printing configuration values in errors or logs. Error messages name the variable, never its value.
`node --env-file=.env app.js` (Node 20.6+) loads a `.env` file without `dotenv`. For development only; production secrets come from the platform.
Makes the configuration object read-only, so no code can change settings at runtime.
